description: Build a home gym equipment plan that fits your space, ceiling and budget. Inputs: space_sqm, optional ceiling_height_cm, budget, goals[] (strength, hypertrophy, conditioning, general), region (EU or US). Returns equipment with fit flags (fits_space, fits_ceiling), cost, weight capacity, plate/bar compatibility, third-party testing and plain store URLs, plus total cost, budget remaining, cheaper alternatives and space notes. Read-only.
name: plan_home_gym
title: Plan a home gym
